title: Superior air force authority
text:
89. Superior air force authority.—For the purposes of sections 87 and 88, a “superior air force

authority” means—

(a) in the case of punishments awarded by a commanding officer, any officer superior in

command to such commanding officer;

(b) in the case of punishments awarded by any other authority, the Central Government, [the

Chief of the Air Staff] or other officer specified by [the Chief of the Air Staff].
